completeness.detail: non-null cell fraction across samples + all modality tables

range_validity.detail: clinical values within physiologically plausible bounds

referential_integrity.detail: every sample has a row in all 4 modality tables

checklist.control_description: Every lineage record identifies the source script/table that produced it.
Lineage and compliance reports are stored as structured, human-readable JSON/CSV, not opaque binaries.
Every lineage record carries an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at the moment of the transform.
Raw simulated source tables are hashed and logged before any downstream transform (first lineage step per table).
Data-integrity dimension scores (completeness, range validity, uniqueness, referential integrity) are computed, not asserted.
Completeness sub-score covers every cell in every consolidated table, including injected defects.
Reproducibility check verifies identical outputs (tables, biomarkers, integrity scores) across two independent runs from the same seed.
Lineage ledger is append-only (JSONL) and never overwritten within a run.
Lineage ledger, discovered biomarkers, and compliance report are all persisted to disk under data/ and output/ for retrieval/audit.
Lineage ledger functions as a computer-generated, time-stamped audit trail of data creation/modification (sec. 11.10(e)).
Content hashing (SHA-256) of each consolidated table detects any unintended alteration of records (sec. 11.10(a)).
Pipeline re-execution with identical seed yields statistically identical results, supporting process validation.
